description: Round 1 requests changes; the Implementation Agent appends a fix and accepts; round 2 approves the new head and the Story reaches Passing.

issues.title: Add the greeting
issues.body:
## What to build
A greeting.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] the greeting exists

Parent: None
Depends on: None

literal-noop.why: A response with no commit and every finding unresolved is not an answer: refused and escalated.

known_defect.why: The no-op answer is accepted as an answer and the round is spent.

empty-usage.why: A responder that returns nothing must not be relaunched until the window closes.

known_defect.why: Invalid output is retryable, so the responder is relaunched every poll.

invalid-output.why: A responder whose output never validates must not be relaunched until the window closes.

known_defect.why: Invalid output is retryable, so the responder is relaunched every poll.

session-limit.why: A responder out of session budget spends no round; the Story waits In Review.

commit-no-push.why: Ralph pushes the response's fix commit, so an agent that only commits still completes.

amend-history.why: A response that rewrites the reviewed commit is refused; repeated refusals must end the Story.

known_defect.why: The refusal is never recorded, so every Tick answers again, forever.
